Hanwha Ocean is embarking on a journey to transition from a traditional shipbuilder to an Engineering, Procurement, Construction, Installation, and Operation (EPCI(O)) solution provider, offering products such as FPSO, FLNG, Offshore Renewables and other Floating Production Units.
The Offshore Business Division recently expanded its global footprint by establishing a new Global Business Centers in North America and Europe with the intention of becoming a project-centric and client-driven business organization. This transformation aims to offer enhanced project execution and knowledge-driven operational models by bridging the upstream culture of three continents across Asia, Europe, and America.
Summary
The Project Controls Manager (PCM) plays a crucial role in overseeing and implementing project controls activities, including cost management, planning and scheduling, progress monitoring, risk evaluation, change management, and reporting. These activities are conducted in accordance with both contractual obligations and internal standards throughout all stages of the project. The PCM is tasked with providing regular updates on project status, emphasizing key performance indicators, and delivering estimates and forecasts for the remaining project duration. Additionally, the PCM identifies potential risks and opportunities, supplying the Project Team with vital information to ensure effective project management and recommending corrective actions when necessary.
Accountabilities

  • Coordinate and support the development of Project Controls policies, procedures, systems & tools.
  • Ensure OBU Project Controls standards, policies, and procedures are adhered to on all OBU projects.
  • Accountable for the management of all planning and scheduling efforts for all projects including bid proposals, Pre-FEED/FEED, and EPC.
  • Accountable for the management of all cost control efforts including change management for all projects including bid proposals, Pre-FEED/FEED, and EPC.
  • Coordinate and support the development of business units / department budgets and develop consistent budget templates for presentation to OBU senior management.
  • Work with Estimating and Commercial team to interpret cost estimates into pricing for proposals.
  • Accountable for the development of project contingencies, work closely with Risk Manager in interpreting risks identified for the development of contingencies.
  • Support the Contracts Managers in adherence to contract T&Cs relating to cost and schedule issues at each project location.
  • Coordinate with corporate Finance and Accounting ensuring project costs are appropriately accounted for.
  • Work with Procurement/Supply Chain in development of RFQs, evaluation of quotations relating to cost and schedule.
  • Accountable for all progress reporting, weekly, monthly, quarterly, yearly for projects.
  • Work closely with yard Project Controls Managers in their efforts to manage projects (reporting, resources, training, etc.)
  • Continuously improve Projects Controls policies, procedures, systems, and tools.
  • Prepare and report KPIs for tendering and projects.
  • Manage the project progress reporting dashboard ensuring data are accurate and timely.
  • Establish the Project Controls Plan in accordance with the contract & Project Execution Plan (PEP) and communicate it with the relevant stakeholders.
  • Ensure efficient resource management by optimizing allocation and clearly defining each individual’s role and responsibility within the actual project.
  • Ensure that all Project Controls functions are properly set up, the budget is seamlessly transferred from the WIN phase to project phase, WBS structures are established with booking/task codes in line with the contract and PEP, and project planning, progress measurement systems, as well as internal and external reporting including KPIs, are effectively implemented.
  • Ensure progress on the 90-day start-up plan during the initial project setup phase to establish the Control Baseline
  • Establish a project baseline schedule aligned with contract milestones and deliverables, ensuring it gains stakeholders’ approval.
Qualifications And Experience
  • 10+ years of experience in oil and gas industry within the Project Controls function.
  • 5+ years of leadership experience, preferably as a Project Controls Manager.
  • Experience of major offshore project execution
  • Experience in the FPSO/FSO/FLNG sector highly desired.
  • Experience in Project Controls of EPCI projects including work at the yard.
  • Technical education at Bachelor level, Masters preferred.
  • Proficient in common computer applications with proficient MS Excel skills and Primavera P6 software.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written English in report writing, presentations, diplomacy and assertiveness is demanded.
  • Ability to independently prioritize tasks.
  • Ability to be pro-active and able to work and communicate with all team members and clients in achievement of the above responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of industry standard Project Controls best practices, AACE standards.

Your role is to oversee our video production ecosystem, ensuring flawless execution of 45-80 high-quality videos monthly (with a team of 3-5 people) while maintaining exceptional client satisfaction and channel growth.

Are you obsessed with YouTube (or Social Media)success? Someone who lives and breathes video optimization? Do you have a talent for managing multiple brand voices and coordinating creative teams? Are you equally comfortable diving into analytics and providing strategic direction? If so, we might be the perfect match.

Core Responsibilities

  • Lead entire video production workflow from raw footage to final publishing
  • Coordinate resources across editing, thumbnail, and publishing teams
  • Manage channel optimization and publishing schedules for multiple real estate clients
  • Track and optimize team capacity and production efficiency
  • Implement and refine production SOPs and best practices
  • Monitor YouTube analytics and adjust strategies for maximum channel growth
  • Ensure consistent 48-72 hour turnaround times while maintaining quality standards
  • Drive client success metrics including subscriber growth and lead generation

Requirements

  • 2+ years experience in video production management, preferably in YouTube content
  • Strong understanding of YouTube best practices and optimization strategies
  • Experience managing creative teams and coordinating multiple projects
  • Proficiency with project management tools (Asana preferred)
  • Excellence in organization and timeline management
  • Strong analytical skills for performance tracking and optimization
  • Outstanding communication abilities

Expected Results

  • 45-60+ videos consistently delivered monthly
  • 90%+ on-time delivery rate
  • Client channels achieving 100-1000 subscriber growth monthly
  • Support of client revenue goals ($7.5-10M+ in sales per client)
  • Seamless team coordination and workflow optimization

Who we are

A Impact Media is a specialized creative agency helping real estate professionals build their own media brands instead of buying leads. We transform top-producing agents and teams (doing $10M to $1B+/YR in annual volume) into local market authorities through done-for-you YouTube content, email marketing, and brand development.

Our dedicated team of 30+ creative professionals has generated over 10M+ YouTube views and helped our clients achieve more than $250M in sales. We're not just a service provider we're a growth partner obsessed with turning real estate professionals into media companies that naturally attract the right clients and team members.

With a track record of producing over 1,200 videos, 3,600+ thumbnails, and hundreds of newsletters for industry leaders, we combine creative excellence with proven systems to deliver consistent results. Our core values of proactive curiosity, transparent communication, extreme accountability, and beyond excellence drive everything we do.

  • All job offers start with a 30 to 60-day paid trial to make sure that we're the right fit for each other.

Para contribuir com sua saúde oferecemos o CLUDE SAÚDE – Programa de serviços como Telemedicina e Telepsicologia oferecendo suporte e recursos para cuidar da sua saúde física e mental.

Somos uma empresa da área de saúde e preocupados em seu bem-estar, oferecemos o PLANO DE SAÚDE e o PLANO ODONTOLÓGICO.

Sobre a GHENOVA Brasil
A GHENOVA é uma empresa de engenharia consultiva multidisciplinar, com mais de 25 anos de experiência no desenvolvimento de projetos nos mercados nacional e internacional. Atuamos com excelência em Engenharia e Tecnologia, sempre valorizando nossos profissionais e promovendo um ambiente de crescimento e inovação.

  • Domínio em modelagem 3D;
  • Experiência em software AVEVA será imprescindível;
  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de outfitting estrutural, preferencialmente no setor naval ou offshore;

Diferenciais:
  • Vivência em projetos internacionais;

  • Participação em projetos de grande porte e impacto internacional;

About the project:

As a Senior Backend Typescript/Node Engineer , you will be joining a team focused on integrating clients with external partners and platforms. This includes enabling backend APIs to support billing integrations, subscription management, cancellations, and user features like “Continue Watching” across partner apps.

How your day-to-day work will look like

Design and implement scalable backend services in AWS.

Build and maintain serverless functions using AWS Lambda.

Collaborate with external partners to integrate the client into their systems.

Work on API development for subscription flows, billing, and user data.

Support microservices architecture and data handling (e.g., S3).

This would make you the ideal candidate

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

5+ Years of backend development experience, with strong hands-on work in cloud environments.

Experience developing APIs in at least two of the following languages: TypeScript and Node.js.

Proven experience working with AWS, particularly Lambda and related services.

Solid understanding of serverless architecture.

Comfortable working in cross-functional teams and collaborating with external stakeholders.

Familiarity with microservices architecture and handling AWS storage services like S3.

Ability to design backend systems with scalability and partner integration in mind.

Advanced English Level is required for this role as you will work with US clients. Effective communication in English is essential to deliver the best solutions to our clients and expand your horizons.

What to expect from our hiring process

1. Let’s chat about your experience!

2. Impress our recruiters, and you’ll move on to a technical interview with our top developers.

3. Nail that, and you’ll meet our client - your final step to joining our amazing team!

Analista de Engenharia Pleno (Automação)

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022, a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Apoiar no desenvolvimento de padrões técnicos para automação e sensoriamento aplicáveis em todo o grupo Aegea, garantindo consistência e eficiência.
  • Auxiliar no desenvolvimento e revisão de lógicas de controle para CLPs Siemens e Schneider, garantindo a conformidade com os padrões.
  • Realizar auditorias técnicas e avaliações de projetos para garantir que os padrões de automação e instrumentação sejam mantidos.
  • Auxiliar na configuração e programação de CLPs Siemens e Schneider para alinhar projetos ao modelo padronizado do grupo e ajustar os sistemas a condições específicas de cada unidade.
  • Prestar suporte técnico em campo para as unidades operacionais, garantindo o funcionamento adequado dos sistemas de automação.
  • Realizar treinamentos e workshops para alinhar o conhecimento técnico à padronização.
  • Documentar intervenções em campo, mantendo registros detalhados para suporte à manutenção e auditorias.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação: Engenharia Elétrica, Controle e Automação, Mecatrônica ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência com CLPs Siemens/Schneider, redes industriais e instrumentação/automação.
  • Conhecimento em leitura e revisão de projetos, diagramas elétricos e normas técnicas.
  • Capacidade de identificar desvios, propor melhorias e registrar lições aprendidas.
  • Interesse em desenvolver competências técnicas em automação, IoT e análise de dados.
  • Disposição para atuar em equipe, dialogar com operação, manutenção e engenharia.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar no modelo híbrido no Rio de Janeiro/RJ (3 dias presenciais e 2 dias remotos).

description:
We are the Latin American branch of Match Group, the world's largest company for dating websites and apps. You've probably heard of some of our brands: Match.com, Tinder, OkCupid, Par Perfeito, Divino Amor, Our Time, Hinge, Stir, and many more!

Our mission is simple: to create meaningful connections for every person everywhere. Passion drives us, and we believe in love. We are relentless in our pursuit to build and integrate technology that will help connect people.

Currently, the group's brands worldwide include:

  • Par Perfeito - a pioneering brand in Brazil and the largest in online serious relationships.
  • Hinge - an inclusive dating app for real people looking to meet others and pursue real-life relationships.
  • POF - a dating website for people seeking casual or serious relationships.
  • Match.com - the world's largest dating site.
  • Tinder - the leading global app to meet new people.

Match Group is a leading provider of dating products across the globe. Our portfolio includes Tinder, Match, Hinge, PlentyOfFish, The League, and others, each designed to spark meaningful connections for singles worldwide. Creating a sense of belonging doesn’t stop at our products - it’s the foundation of every team we hire.

The Match Growth & Revenue team is looking for a Quantitative Analyst to join their newly formed Data Science pod. This new position is an exciting opportunity to apply insights and identify wins across our portfolio of brands (including Match, OKCupid, and PlentyOfFish). The role will drive tangible business impact through the analysis of test results and ecosystem trends, collaboration with our Product and Development groups, and quantitative research on how our users find love.

When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life (IRL). We think the same is true for doing our best work so we work together IRL in our Dallas office 2 days/week.

How You'll Make An Impact:

  • Liaise with individual brands to understand their business models, track ecosystem trends, and identify opportunities across the portfolio
  • Conduct quantitative research to better understand user behavior and inform future initiatives
  • Collaborate with other teams, including Product and Development, to shepherd projects from ideation to delivery

Analista de Desembaraço Junior - Comércio Exterior

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Desembaraço Pleno para integrar nosso time!

Essa pessoa será responsável por conduzir atividades operacionais e analíticas relacionadas ao desembaraço aduaneiro de importação e exportação. Procuramos alguém com atenção a detalhes, senso de urgência e forte conhecimento em processos documentais e sistêmicos do Comércio Exterior.

Responsabilidades:

  1. Emitir relatórios atualizados dos processos em andamento
  2. Realizar análise documental (conhecimento de carga, invoice, packing list)
  3. Controlar prazos de vencimento das armazenagens
  4. Garantir o correto preenchimento dos sistemas internos e do cliente
  5. Analisar e aprovar drafts de Licença de Importação (LI), com posterior registro
  6. Acompanhar chegada dos embarques via CCT/CE
  7. Analisar e aprovar drafts de Declaração de Importação (DI), com posterior registro
  8. Analisar e aprovar drafts de Declaração Única de Exportação (DUE), com posterior registro
  9. Prestar suporte operacional à equipe do departamento
  10. Apoiar diretamente o gestor da área com rotinas e demandas operacionais

Requisitos:

  1. Ensino superior completo ou cursando em Relações Internacionais, Comércio Exterior, Administração, Logística ou áreas correlatas
  2. Conhecimento em processos de importação e exportação
  3. Familiaridade com documentos e rotinas de desembaraço aduaneiro
  4. Domínio de ferramentas e sistemas relacionados à área
  5. Organização, atenção aos detalhes e foco em prazos
  6. Boa comunicação e habilidade para trabalhar em equipe
  7. Proatividade e responsabilidade nas entregas

Se você busca uma oportunidade para atuar com protagonismo em uma área estratégica, com desafios operacionais e oportunidade de desenvolvimento profissional no Comércio Exterior, essa vaga é para você.

Envie seu currículo e venha fazer parte do nosso time!

title: PROGRAMA DE ESTAGIO
description:
Sobre a vaga:

Você gosta de desafios e quer começar sua carreira em uma empresa global, inovadora e referência no mercado imobiliário?

Essa é a sua chance de fazer parte da CBRE, líder mundial em consultoria, comercialização e serviços imobiliários, com aproximadamente 100.000 funcionários presentes em mais de 100 países.

No Brasil desde 1979, a CBRE atua nacionalmente através de seus 8 escritórios e +1.800 funcionários.

Estamos em busca de Jovens Talentos para o cargo de Estagiário no Rio de Janeiro, para integrar nosso time de Land Services (Consultoria e Desenvolvimento Imobiliário). Veja abaixo os principais requisitos e aprendizados da vaga:

Formação Acadêmica:

Cursando os 02 (dois) últimos anos do Ensino Superior nas áreas de:

  • Engenharias
  • Administração

Requisitos:

  • Capacidade de comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Conhecimento intermediário do pacote office (Word, Excel, Power Point) e com desenvoltura comercial.
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente.
  • Espanhol (desejável).

Aprendizado na Equipe de Land Services:

  • Prospecção de novos clientes e terrenos (mapeamento de imóveis e oportunidades nas regiões de atuação da empresa).
  • Estudos de vocação e viabilidade para desenvolvimento imobiliário (residencial, escritórios, galpões logísticos, mixed use, entre outros).
  • Análise de Legislação Urbana (usos permitidos, potencial construtivo e outros parâmetros urbanísticos).
  • Suporte à Negociação de terrenos para negócios imobiliários.
  • Visibilidade de mercado, com participação em reuniões com grandes players do mercado;
  • Ferramentas e softwares (Pacote Office, Salesforce, Google Earth Pro, CBRE Plus, entre outros).

Esteja preparado para uma carreira desafiadora e de grande desenvolvimento no setor imobiliário!

A CBRE oferece igualdade de oportunidades em todos os processos seletivos, exercendo uma cultura de inclusão e não discriminação, tomamos decisões de contratação com base no mérito.

title: Advogado(a) Pleno
description:
Job type: Full-time employee

Estamos buscando um(a) Advogado(a) Pleno para integrar nossa equipe jurídica presencial no Rio de Janeiro. Sua missão será atuar em diversas áreas do direito, com foco em trabalhista, tributário, societário e contratos.

• Atuar de forma preventiva (propondo ações e assessorando outros setores da empresa) e repressiva (defendendo a empresa em ações judiciais), elaborar recursos, receber intimações, notificações, analisar processos e documentos no fórum, acompanhar processos em 1ª e 2ª instância, analisar documentos para montar a defesa da empresa, contribuindo para a redução de custos;

• Analisar, revisar e validar contratos firmados com clientes, fornecedores e parceiros, garantindo conformidade com as normas legais e os interesses da empresa. Prevenir litígios contratuais por meio da estruturação de cláusulas claras, seguras e bem definidas;

• Elaborar a matriz de riscos jurídicos para a operação da empresa no Brasil, incluindo condições, custos e possíveis reclamações de ordem comercial, trabalhista, marítima, societária, etc;

• Redigir pareceres jurídicos e relatórios técnicos destinados à Diretoria Geral e à área jurídica, auxiliando na tomada de decisões estratégicas, conforme as mudanças na legislação e regulamentos aplicáveis à atividade da empresa;

• Gerenciar assuntos relacionados à JUCERJA (Junta Comercial do Estado do Rio de Janeiro), ao Cartório Marítimo e ao Tribunal Marítimo;

• Prestar pareceres relacionados a assuntos internos da companhia que exijam aconselhamento jurídico.

Requisitos:

  1. Formação em Direito e registro ativo na OAB;
  2. Experiência comprovada em atuação nas áreas trabalhista, tributária, societária e contratos;
  3. Conhecimento em LGPD e Compliance será um diferencial;
  4. Habilidades de comunicação e negociação;
  5. Capacidade de trabalho em equipe e autonomia;
  6. Inglês e espanhol intermediário será um diferencial.

Regime de trabalho: Presencial

Benefícios:

  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Vale alimentação;
  • Vale refeição;
  • Previdência privada;
  • Programas de assistência ao colaborador (Meu amigo Doutor e Use Vida).

Sobre a empresa:

Somos uma empresa brasileira de navegação (EBN), atuando desde 2011 na prestação de serviços de apoio marítimo offshore à indústria de petróleo & gás. Nossas embarcações operam transporte de cargas sólidas, líquidas e de pessoas.

Contamos com escritórios e bases operacionais no Sudeste (Rio de Janeiro) e Nordeste (Sergipe e Rio Grande do Norte), além de uma frota de 14 FSVs, 4 Surfers e 2 PSVs, apoiando o setor em todo o país.

Nosso propósito é sermos reconhecidos como uma referência na gestão de operações na navegação de apoio marítimo (offshore), com foco na Excelência Operacional. Com uma equipe de mais de 400 pessoas, estamos em constante crescimento. Venha fazer parte da equipe da Baru!

title: Cientista de Dados Pleno
description:
Atuação hibrida na Barra da Tijuca - RJ.

Atividades:

  • Coletar, processar e analisar grandes volumes de dados estruturados e não estruturados para identificar padrões, tendências e insights que suportem a tomada de decisões estratégicas.
  • Desenvolver modelos preditivos e algoritmos de machine learning para resolver problemas complexos de negócios, melhorando a eficiência e otimizando processos.
  • Colaborar com stakeholders de diferentes áreas para entender suas necessidades de dados e criar soluções que atendam às suas demandas.
  • Implementar soluções de data science utilizando linguagens de programação como Python, R e frameworks como TensorFlow, Scikit-learn ou PyTorch.
  • Realizar análises exploratórias de dados (EDA) e criar relatórios visuais que comuniquem de forma clara os insights e resultados obtidos.
  • Garantir a qualidade dos dados e a integridade dos modelos desenvolvidos, ajustando-os conforme necessário para maximizar sua precisão e utilidade.
  • Acompanhar as tendências e avanços nas áreas de ciência de dados, inteligência artificial e machine learning para trazer inovações para a empresa.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes de engenharia de dados e analistas de BI para integrar soluções de dados nos sistemas e processos da empresa.

Requisitos:

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática, Engenharia ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Necessário experiência com IA generativa
  • Experiência em ciência de dados, machine learning ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento profundo de técnicas estatísticas e de modelagem, algoritmos de machine learning e mineração de dados.
  • Proficiência em linguagens de programação como Python ou R, além de experiência com SQL.
  • Experiência com big data e ferramentas de processamento distribuído (ex.: Hadoop, Spark).
  • Conhecimento de visualização de dados utilizando ferramentas como Power BI, Tableau ou Matplotlib/Seaborn.
  • Fluência em inglês; conhecimentos adicionais em outros idiomas são um diferencial.

Competências:

  • Habilidade de trabalhar com grandes conjuntos de dados e encontrar insights que agreguem valor ao negócio.
  • Capacidade analítica excepcional e forte orientação para a resolução de problemas.
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade de traduzir resultados técnicos em linguagem de negócios.
  • Proatividade e vontade de aprender novas técnicas e ferramentas.
  • Excelentes habilidades de colaboração e trabalho em equipe.
  • Capacidade de priorizar e gerenciar múltiplos projetos simultaneamente.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com deep learning e redes neurais.
  • Certificações em Data Science ou Machine Learning.
  • Experiência em empresas de tecnologia ou consultoria com foco em projetos de dados e IA.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis e DevOps aplicados a projetos de dados.

  • Proatividade e capacidade de autoaprendizado.

  • Experiência em governança de dados e regulamentações de proteção de dados.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização de dados e BI (ex.: Power BI, Tableau).
  • Experiência em metodologias ágeis de desenvolvimento.

title: Analista de Asset Management Imobiliário – Real Estate (Multifamily EUA)
description:
Analista de Asset Management Imobiliário – Real Estate (Multifamily EUA)

O Grupo Leste é um gestora independente de investimentos alternativos com um compromisso firme em oferecer retornos consistentes ajustados ao risco.

Os membros da nossa equipe e os fornecedores devem refletir a diversidade do mundo e serem empoderados a compartilhar uma variedade de pontos de vista, perspectivas e conhecimento para respondermos às necessidades de nossos consumidores e aos seus variados ideais de beleza.

Por isso, para todas as nossas vagas, valorizamos a diversidade em todos os seus aspectos.
Missão
O(a) Analista Jr de Biodiversidade atuará em projetos estratégicos, tanto nacionais quanto internacionais, que envolvem acesso ao patrimônio genético, ao conhecimento tradicional associado e sobre a repartição de benefícios para conservação e uso sustentável da biodiversidade. O foco principal da função será garantir o cumprimento da Lei 13.123/2015, além de dar suporte técnico e regulatório em todas as etapas do ciclo de vida dos produtos L'Oréal que utilizam componentes da biodiversidade brasileira.

  • Gestão Regulatória e Conformidade:
    • Avaliar e categorizar espécies e insumos que fazem parte do da biodiversidade brasileira
    • Monitorar o ciclo de vida dos produtos com biodiversidade brasileira, assegurando a total conformidade com a legislação brasileira (Lei 13.123/2015).
    • Realizar o registro, notificação e envio de informações via Sistema Nacional de Gestão do Patrimônio Genético e do Conhecimento Tradicional Associado (SisGen).
    • Acompanhar e analisar continuamente a legislação nacional e outras normativas relacionadas.
  • Análise Técnica e Pesquisa:
    • Realizar análises de matérias-primas e produtos, avaliando os riscos das atividades que envolvem componentes da BDB
    • Analisar usos tradicionais e aplicações de espécies, identificando possíveis Conhecimentos Tradicionais Associados.
  • Comunicação e Relacionamento:
    • Acompanhar a execução dos projetos de repartição de benefícios, garantindo sua conformidade e progresso.
    • Representar a área em apresentações internas e externas sobre o tema da biodiversidade.
Qualificações e Habilidades Necessárias
  • Formação Acadêmica: Superior completo em Biologia, Engenharia Ambiental, Química, Biotecnologia e áreas correlatas
  • Conhecimento Específico:
    • Capacidade analítica e atenção aos detalhes para realização dos processos de rotina da área
    • Entendimento da Lei 13.123/2015 (Lei da Biodiversidade Brasileira) e do Protocolo de Nagoya.
    • Familiaridade e experiência prévia com o Sistema Nacional de Gestão do Patrimônio Genético e do Conhecimento Tradicional Associado (SisGen) é altamente desejável.
    • Habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita em português. Inglês avançado será um diferencial
  • Competências Pessoais:

Overview:
Varsity Tutors, a Nerdy company, is seeking high-performing sales professionals based in Brazil, Argentina, Chile, or Costa Rica to join our Customer Retention team. This is not your typical support role — this is a sales-focused position where your primary responsibility is to retain revenue, overcome objections, and turn cancel requests into renewed confidence in our product .
We are transforming how people learn through technology and personalized education solutions. Our Customer Retention Specialists are closers who bring empathy, resilience, and strong sales instincts to every conversation. If you excel at consultative selling, thrive in high-stakes conversations, and are passionate about education, this is your chance to make a direct impact — and get rewarded for it.
This is a remote, full-time role focused on handling high-level customer escalations, preventing churn, and driving renewals. You'll work closely with our sales and training teams, use cutting-edge tools like Nerdy AI, and be backed by a coaching-driven culture that's committed to helping you succeed.
Why Nerdy?

  • Innovative Technology: Be a part of a leading US private tutoring company changing the game in education with innovative, tech-driven learning solutions.
  • Career Growth Opportunities: This is a fully remote, full-time position that offers on the job training and future opportunities into training, management, and other parts of the business based on individual performance. Excel in your role and watch your career and earnings soar!
  • Uncapped Earning Potential: Enjoy competitive base compensation with generous commission structures that reward your success.
  • Lucrative Bonuses: Achieve and surpass your retention/renewal targets to unlock exciting performance bonuses and incentives.
  • Make a Difference: Help students achieve their learning goals and make a real impact on their educational journey.
Location: Fully Remote - Based in Brazil, Argentina, Chile or Costa Rica
Compensation/Benefits:
  • Competitive Hourly Rate ($12/hr USD)
  • Full-Time Position (40 hours per week, evenings and weekends required)
  • Fully Remote Position
  • A once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to help transform how the world learns!
  • A fast-paced, collaborative, and team-oriented work environment with plenty of training and a feedback-rich culture
About Nerdy:
Nerdy (NYSE: NRDY), the parent company of Varsity Tutors, is a leading platform for live online learning, with a mission to transform the way people learn through technology. The Company's purpose-built proprietary platform leverages technology, including AI, to connect learners of all ages to experts, delivering superior value on both sides of the network. Nerdy's comprehensive learning destination provides learning experiences across 3,000+ subjects and multiple formats—including one-on-one instruction, small group classes, large format group classes, on-demand study support, and adaptive self-study. Nerdy's flagship business, Varsity Tutors, is one of the nation's largest platforms for live online tutoring and classes. Its solutions are available directly to students and consumers, as well as through schools and other institutions. Learn more about Nerdy at shareholder letters below explain the product and strategy and are the most effective way to learn about what the company is building.

  • Q4-2024 Shareholder Letter
  • Q3-2024 Shareholder Letter

  • Fluent in English (written and spoken); strong verbal persuasion skills required.
  • 3+ years of experience in sales, customer retention, account management, or high-stakes customer service — preferably in phone-based or consultative roles.
  • Demonstrated success in meeting sales or revenue retention goals, with the ability to manage objections and close deals under pressure.
  • High empathy and emotional intelligence, with the ability to understand families' educational needs and make product/service recommendations.
  • Experience handling customer escalations or save/cancel conversations with a focus on solution-selling.
  • Tech-savvy, with the ability to use AI tools and CRM systems to support decision-making and streamline workflows. Comfortable in a fast-paced, goal-driven environment where priorities can shift quickly and performance is highly visible.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills; able to multitask and stay focused.
  • Willing to work a full-time schedule that includes at least evenings and weekend shifts.
  • Education, teaching, or tutoring experience is preferred, but not required.
  • Network requirements: High-speed Internet access (50 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload) via wired ethernet connection; no Wi-Fi, Satellite or Cellular Hotspot or Cellular Internet.
  • Understand and appreciate that Nerdy is an apolitical company and that we can have the largest impact if we are united in our focus on helping people learn and not divided or distracted by advancing unrelated causes.
Responsibilities:
  • Own and manage a high volume of inbound calls from customers considering cancellation, with a focus on retaining revenue and delivering value.
  • Act as a consultative sales professional, uncovering customer needs and recommending solutions that align with their goals (e.g., tutoring programs, live classes, homeschool support).
  • Deflect cancellations through persuasive, empathetic, and informed conversations that increase customer confidence and trust in Nerdy's offerings.

  • Use Nerdy AI and internal systems to guide conversations, surface the right offerings, and accelerate resolutions.

  • Actively implement coaching and feedback in pursuit of providing customers with a high quality experience.
What Success Looks Like:
  • You consistently save at-risk customers by understanding their needs and recommending the right Nerdy product or service.
  • You become a trusted guide for families, showing them how Nerdy's learning solutions can evolve with their child's journey.
  • You're hitting or exceeding your weekly and monthly revenue retention targets, and earning strong commissions as a result.

Ela atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, alinhada às suas políticas de saúde e educação, sendo também uma organização social habilitada em diversos estados, gerenciando serviços e organizações de saúde por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A missão principal da associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde, focada no tratamento, prevenção de doenças e promoção da saúde em níveis primário, secundário e terciário, com forte vínculo com a comunidade local, reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento institucional, a SPDM expande suas áreas de atuação, incluindo projetos em desenvolvimento na assistência social e na educação. Essas atividades consolidam a sua posição como uma grande instituição filantrópica, buscando sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências — Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação — são gerenciadas por profissionais altamente capacitados e experientes.

Dispomos de um banco de talentos exclusivo para profissionais com deficiência. Inscreva-se para que possamos direcionar você às vagas disponíveis conforme suas qualificações!

  • Formação de acordo com a área de interesse;
  • Experiência mínima de 6 meses na área;
  • Salário + Benefícios;
  • Escala e horário de trabalho: a definir;
  • Local de trabalho: zonas Norte, Oeste e Centro do Rio de Janeiro;
  • Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores ou prestadores de serviço, com vínculos de parentesco ou afinidade, ou que atuem em modalidades contratuais distintas, devem consultar as normas de RH vigentes com o setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

A SPDM também oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira para pessoas com deficiência, divulgando periodicamente anúncios em jornais principais de São Paulo e demais municípios onde atua.

Missão: Promover ações em saúde integradas à gestão pública, beneficiando a população de forma ética, humanizada, com alta qualidade técnica, compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão: Ser referência na gestão de serviços de saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis de assistência e garantindo atendimento de qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

Quem somos?

Em parceria com o Complexo Hospitalar Souza Aguiar, o maior hospital de emergência da América Latina, estamos redefinindo os padrões de atendimento em saúde.
O que buscamos?
  • Estamos buscando um profissional que irá atuar em nosso hospital, garantindo a segurança, o controle de acesso e o atendimento aos pacientes, colaboradores e visitantes. O profissional será responsável por zelar pela tranquilidade do ambiente hospitalar, seguindo os protocolos de segurança e oferecendo um atendimento humanizado.

  • Monitorar o fluxo de pessoas nas entradas e saídas, mantendo a ordem e segurança no ambiente;
  • Acionar a equipe de segurança e/ou assistência médica em situações de emergência ou ocorrências no local;
  • Elaborar relatórios diários de controle de acesso e registrar ocorrências relevantes.
Local de trabalho: Complexo Hospitalar Souza Aguiar. Endereço: Praça da República, 111, Centro, Rio de Janeiro

Requisitos

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Experiência prévia como porteiro, preferencialmente em ambiente hospitalar ou em áreas de grande fluxo de pessoas;

  • Fortes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar efetivamente em equipe.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em horários flexíveis, incluindo fins de semana e feriados, quando necessário.

Benefícios

  • Day off no aniversário: Proporcionando um dia de descanso para comemorar seu aniversário.

description:

Select how often (in days) to receive an alert:

Wärtsilä Parts and Field Service is now looking for an enthusiastic Team Leader Resources, In-Situ to join our skilled team in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

Wärtsilä is a world leader in marine technology and leading the industry's transformation towards a decarbonised and sustainable future. With the world’s widest portfolio and service network, we – Wärtsilians - deliver efficient, safe, and sustainable integrated products and solutions to enhance the business of our customers. The opportunities presented through digitalisation and new technologies are offering a new era of shipping. Did you know that shipping is the world’s most efficient mode of transportation and that approximately 90% of world trade is carried by sea?
We want to change the course towards an interconnected and cleaner maritime future and are constantly on the lookout for future-oriented talent to join our team and to work towards enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services- together. Are you ready to jump onboard?

What will you be doing?

As a Team Leader In-Situ Resources, you will be responsible for leading and developing a In-Situ Resources Team consisting of In-Situ Machining Engineers and Technicians in Brazil, in accordance with the strategy, action plan and business needs.

Effective July 2025, Wärtsilä Brazil will implement a new hybrid work model. Most employees who live within 65 kilometres of an office will work 6 days per month in office. This model will provide our employees the flexibility of working from home, while also providing the benefits of in-person collaboration. We will be happy to provide more information during your interview process.

This position reports to the In-Situ Resources Manager .

Candidates are expected to display a high level of critical thinking and reasoning skills, identify as high performers, as well as being self-motivating.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Evaluate the In-Situ demand during the year and define appropriate actions (including recruiting).
  • Development of your team competencies as required to address current and future needs.
  • Manage personnel responsibilities including selection, training, performance appraisal, discipline, and safety in the field. Foster team development and a continuous learning environment. Monitor team performance and provide feedback for improvement.
  • Ensure that the team is utilized effectively, having the right people in the right place at the right time.
  • Foster strategic relationships with institutes of leaning to attract and develop talent.
  • Manage and maintain internal and external relationships, focused on achieving company targets.
  • Facilitate good collaboration with key stakeholders throughout the delivery chain (Sales, Lifecycle Support, Agreements, Technical Service).
  • Contribute to the annual budget preparation and service forecast evaluations.
  • Set the individual performance and development targets of your team.
  • Monitor and control the monthly process KPIs in Resources, seeking to provide information to those responsible for identifying potential failures and improvements through action plans.
  • To comply with the company's Quality, Health & Safety and Equal Opportunities policies.
  • In addition to the above duties and responsibilities, the post holder must be prepared to undertake such additional duties within their capabilities which may result from changing circumstances, but which may not, of necessity, change the general character or level of responsibility of the post.

Main Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, or technical university or equivalent work experience in a technical service-minded organization is desired
  • Job-related experience with a technical degree and/or bachelor’s degree, and some project management experience or training is required
  • Service management skills and/or experience with coordinating service teams is desirable
  • Experience with reciprocating engines and ancillary equipment in a Mechanical/Maritime environment is required
  • Thorough understanding of the Field Service process
  • English language proficiency (Spanish considered as plus)
  • Be proficient with process tools such as SalesForce (CRM), Qlikview and FS Mobility

As an ideal candidate, we expect you to have:

  • High integrity
  • Passionate about people
  • Strong focus on quality and safety
  • Excellent communication skills (verbal and written) in languages needed to support the team
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Ability to lead persons of different cultural backgrounds
  • Good understand of profit and loss and cost to serve

Successful applicants must be authorized to work in Brazil without sponsorship.

Why you & us?

Wartsila is committed to Employment Equity, supports diversity in the workplace, and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including women, members of visible minorities, Indigenous persons, and persons with disabilities.

If you require accommodation during the recruitment process, please let us know, and we will work with you to support your request.

At Wärtsilä we value, respect and embrace all our differences, and are committed to diversity, inclusion and equal employment opportunities; everyone can be their true self and succeed based on their job-relevant merits and abilities.

Contact & next steps:

Does this sound like the job for you? If yes, wehope to hear from you before the applicationdeadline by submitting your application in our Career portal. title: Team Leader Resources, In-situ
description:
Team Leader Resources, In-Situ

Wärtsilä Parts and Field Service is now looking for an enthusiastic Team Leader Resources, In-Situ to join our skilled team in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

Wärtsilä is a world leader in marine technology and leading the industry's transformation towards a decarbonised and sustainable future. With the world’s widest portfolio and service network, we – Wärtsilians - deliver efficient, safe, and sustainable integrated products and solutions to enhance the business of our customers. The opportunities presented through digitalisation and new technologies are offering a new era of shipping. Did you know that shipping is the world’s most efficient mode of transportation and that approximately 90% of world trade is carried by sea?
We want to change the course towards an interconnected and cleaner maritime future and are constantly on the lookout for future-oriented talent to join our team and to work towards enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services- together. Are you ready to jump onboard?

What will you be doing?

As a Team Leader In-Situ Resources, you will be responsible for leading and developing a In-Situ Resources Team consisting of In-Situ Machining Engineers and Technicians in Brazil, in accordance with the strategy, action plan and business needs.

Effective July 2025, Wärtsilä Brazil will implement a new hybrid work model. Most employees who live within 65 kilometres of an office will work 6 days per month in office. This model will provide our employees the flexibility of working from home, while also providing the benefits of in-person collaboration. We will be happy to provide more information during your interview process.

This position reports to the In-Situ Resources Manager .

Candidates are expected to display a high level of critical thinking and reasoning skills, identify as high performers, as well as being self-motivating.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Evaluate the In-Situ demand during the year and define appropriate actions (including recruiting).
  • Development of your team competencies as required to address current and future needs.
  • Manage personnel responsibilities including selection, training, performance appraisal, discipline, and safety in the field. Foster team development and a continuous learning environment. Monitor team performance and provide feedback for improvement.
  • Ensure that the team is utilized effectively, having the right people in the right place at the right time.
  • Foster strategic relationships with institutes of leaning to attract and develop talent.
  • Manage and maintain internal and external relationships, focused on achieving company targets.
  • Facilitate good collaboration with key stakeholders throughout the delivery chain (Sales, Lifecycle Support, Agreements, Technical Service).
  • Contribute to the annual budget preparation and service forecast evaluations.
  • Set the individual performance and development targets of your team.
  • Monitor and control the monthly process KPIs in Resources, seeking to provide information to those responsible for identifying potential failures and improvements through action plans.
  • To comply with the company's Quality, Health & Safety and Equal Opportunities policies.
  • In addition to the above duties and responsibilities, the post holder must be prepared to undertake such additional duties within their capabilities which may result from changing circumstances, but which may not, of necessity, change the general character or level of responsibility of the post.

Main Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, or technical university or equivalent work experience in a technical service-minded organization is desired
  • Job-related experience with a technical degree and/or bachelor’s degree, and some project management experience or training is required
  • Service management skills and/or experience with coordinating service teams is desirable
  • Experience with reciprocating engines and ancillary equipment in a Mechanical/Maritime environment is required
  • Thorough understanding of the Field Service process
  • English language proficiency (Spanish considered as plus)
  • Be proficient with process tools such as SalesForce (CRM), Qlikview and FS Mobility

As an ideal candidate, we expect you to have:

  • High integrity
  • Passionate about people
  • Customer focus
  • Strong focus on quality and safety
  • Excellent communication skills (verbal and written) in languages needed to support the team
  • Good negotiating skills
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Team player mindset
  • Ability to lead persons of different cultural backgrounds
  • Good understand of profit and loss and cost to serve

Successful applicants must be authorized to work in Brazil without sponsorship.

Why you & us?

Wartsila is committed to Employment Equity, supports diversity in the workplace, and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including women, members of visible minorities, Indigenous persons, and persons with disabilities.

If you require accommodation during the recruitment process, please let us know, and we will work with you to support your request.

At Wärtsilä we value, respect and embrace all our differences, and are committed to diversity, inclusion and equal employment opportunities; everyone can be their true self and succeed based on their job-relevant merits and abilities.

Contact & next steps:

Does this sound like the job for you? If yes, wehope to hear from you before the applicationdeadline by submitting your application in our Career portal. Our recruiting tool recognizes the time zone where the job ad has been published and closes the application period according to the same time zone. We aim to keep you informed along the way.

Open source software is the new default in the enterprise, and Canonical is the new challenger to major enterprise software vendors.
We deliver better open source from the data center to cloud and edge. Our Linux distribution Ubuntu is now the leading platform for public cloud compute, and the favorite platform for software engineers, data scientists and AI developers. Our mission is to accelerate the adoption and quality of open source globally, and our goal is to ship the most software on the planet by cores. A tidal wave of open source innovation is the next phase of the entire enterprise software industry, and we aim to be the most compelling way to ride that wave.
Our customers include Global 500 enterprises and startups. We are expanding our product range from the base operating system - Ubuntu - to full enterprise solutions in infrastructure and applications. We can deliver software defined storage, private cloud solutions, container runtime environments, as well as databases, message queues, identity, observability, analytics, machine learning and web publishing capabilities. Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company. Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute and every category of application.
Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem. We are just over 1,000 colleagues in 70+ countries and $250m in revenue, profitable, on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries. We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.
We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer. This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position, it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long-term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward. If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long term advantage. You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance. In order to be a world leading company we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment which promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do - at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.
In building our sales team, we look for five things:

  • Empathy for the customer - a real understanding of customer needs, industry-specific challenges, and a desire to help customers solve their business problems
  • High intellect - the ability to learn quickly, understand very complex subjects, and communicate clearly to build trust and confidence
  • Passion for technology - a fascination with the state of the art from brilliant people solving hard problems, and fierce competition for large prizes
  • Teamwork - a willingness to help others, to collaborate well with people from different disciplines, and to balance personal and team ambitions
  • Energy - the drive to motivate oneself and others to achieve the best result for the team and our customers
Ubuntu is already very widely adopted which gives us a credible basis for conversations in the market. Nevertheless, it requires real work for sales professionals to build on that adoption to create trusted and profitable commercial relationships with the enterprises in their territory. Our product managers and marketing teams run campaigns to generate awareness, engagement and leads, but you will need to go beyond managing inbound interest to develop the potential of your territory. You will need judgement as to which industries and companies are ready to go deeper with open source and Canonical, and energy to develop relationships in advance of proven interest. We expect professional practice, territory and account planning, as well as clear, complete and continuous reporting on pipeline status and activity, using standard professional tools.
The successful candidate will carry an annual bookings quota within their assigned territory. They should be able to travel regionally for client engagement, industry conferences, and internationally for company events twice a year. They will be expected to demonstrate professionalism and effectiveness, to prospect accounts for new business, maintain and develop existing relationships, and work with colleagues and partners on account strategy. They must be comfortable selling enterprise software, open source, cloud, virtualization, container technologies and technical software solutions to senior levels of the enterprise.
Location: We are expanding our sales organisation globally and have open roles in every region.
What your day will look like
  • Represent the company, its solutions and software, in your territory
  • Build and execute a territory plan to prioritize outreach and prospecting
  • Develop new pipeline through outreach, prospecting, local marketing, and industry events
  • Close contracts to meet and exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets
  • Be mindful and proactive in achieving tactical and strategic objectives
  • Manage customer relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales cycle
  • Work with field engineers to propose solutions that solve our customers' business problems
  • Work with customer success to identify growth opportunities
  • Maintain accurate pipeline data and forecasts within Salesforce
  • Establish productive professional relationships with key influencers and decision makers
What we are looking for in you
  • Bachelor's level degree, preferably in engineering or computer science
  • Experience of open source technology and solutions
  • Detail oriented with effective follow-up
  • Experience in enterprise software or technology sales planning and execution
  • Track record of achievement in sales targets and new account wins
  • Self-discipline and motivation to be successful in a distributed team
  • Professional written and spoken English, as well as any language that may be appropriate for your target market
  • Ability to travel for customer engagements, industry events and company events
Additional Skills Of Interest
  • Specific vertical experience, in particular finance, telco, health, energy, public sector, tech
  • Experience speaking at conferences or industry events
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance when shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven commission structure. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a fully distributed company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

YouTube Manager

When you apply, please make sure the subject line is: "I actually read the instructions"

This position is completely remote and may start part-time or full-time depending on the right fit, with a path to full-time for the right candidate.

Job Overview We are seeking a detail-oriented YouTube Production Manager to join our fast-growing marketing agency that helps top-ranked real estate teams ($10M to $1B/YR+ in annual volume) build their personal media brands. Your role is to oversee our video production ecosystem, ensuring flawless execution of 45-80 high-quality videos monthly (with a team of 3-5 people) while maintaining exceptional client satisfaction and channel growth.

Are you obsessed with YouTube (or Social Media)success? Someone who lives and breathes video optimization? Do you have a talent for managing multiple brand voices and coordinating creative teams? Are you equally comfortable diving into analytics and providing strategic direction? If so, we might be the perfect match.

Core Responsibilities

  • Lead entire video production workflow from raw footage to final publishing
  • Coordinate resources across editing, thumbnail, and publishing teams
  • Manage channel optimization and publishing schedules for multiple real estate clients
  • Track and optimize team capacity and production efficiency
  • Implement and refine production SOPs and best practices
  • Monitor YouTube analytics and adjust strategies for maximum channel growth
  • Ensure consistent 48-72 hour turnaround times while maintaining quality standards
  • Drive client success metrics including subscriber growth and lead generation

Requirements

  • 2+ years experience in video production management, preferably in YouTube content
  • Strong understanding of YouTube best practices and optimization strategies
  • Experience managing creative teams and coordinating multiple projects
  • Proficiency with project management tools (Asana preferred)
  • Excellence in organization and timeline management
  • Strong analytical skills for performance tracking and optimization
  • Outstanding communication abilities

Expected Results

  • 45-60+ videos consistently delivered monthly
  • 90%+ on-time delivery rate
  • Client channels achieving 100-1000 subscriber growth monthly
  • Support of client revenue goals ($7.5-10M+ in sales per client)
  • Seamless team coordination and workflow optimization

Who we are

A Impact Media is a specialized creative agency helping real estate professionals build their own media brands instead of buying leads. We transform top-producing agents and teams (doing $10M to $1B+/YR in annual volume) into local market authorities through done-for-you YouTube content, email marketing, and brand development.

Our dedicated team of 30+ creative professionals has generated over 10M+ YouTube views and helped our clients achieve more than $250M in sales. We're not just a service provider we're a growth partner obsessed with turning real estate professionals into media companies that naturally attract the right clients and team members.

With a track record of producing over 1,200 videos, 3,600+ thumbnails, and hundreds of newsletters for industry leaders, we combine creative excellence with proven systems to deliver consistent results. Our core values of proactive curiosity, transparent communication, extreme accountability, and beyond excellence drive everything we do.

Make sure you're comfortable with:

  • Remote working. This is completely remote (work from home) position.
  • A multi-step hiring process
  • Open opportunities to work as much or as little as you want
  • All job offers start with a 30 to 60-day paid trial to make sure that we're the right fit for each other.
  • Pay ranges depending on skill & experience from $1,400 to $2,400 USD per month, and will progressively increase from onboarding to full time.

To apply: If you're interested, please submit the following:

  1. A link to your resume in PDF format with the following naming convention: (Lastname.Firstname.YouTube-Manager.pdf)
  2. Links to YouTube channels you've managed and their growth metrics
  3. Send a link to your completed personality quiz:
  4. Your answer to this question: What's the most innovative YouTube strategy you've implemented and what were the results?
  5. Your answer to this question: What does this quote mean to you personally? "Work is love made visible" - Khalil Gibran

Submissions should go to:

I will be looking for people who can format their submission in a way that makes it easy for us to review. Remember, in production management you want to help make processes as efficient as possible! I'm happy to answer any questions you may include in your application.

Thank you for your consideration and best of luck on your job search!

title: HR Business Partner
description:
Career Area:

Human Resources

Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you'rejoining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don'tjust talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

We are Hiring! Join a team where your insights shape the future of our people and culture.

Are you passionate about creating a thriving workplace where people feel valued, supported, and empowered? We’re looking for anHR Business Partnerwho’s ready to make a real impact by driving employee engagement, supporting leadership, and enhancing organizational effectiveness.

What You will Do

As a strategic partner to our leadership team, you will:

  • Provide expert guidance on employee relations, performance management, and organizational development.

  • Collaborate with senior leaders to shape talent strategies and improve employee experience.

  • Lead compensation and performance evaluation programs, ensuring fairness and alignment with business goals.

  • Support transitions with empathy—handling outplacement counseling and exit interviews.

  • Conduct organizational assessments and recommend impactful solutions.

What You Bring

  • A degree in HR, Business, or related field—or equivalent experience.

  • Strong business acumen and the ability to align HR strategies with company goals.

  • Experience navigating employee relations with professionalism and care.

  • A collaborative mindset and excellent interpersonal skills.

  • Confidence in data gathering, reporting, and making informed decisions.

  • English proficiency is preferred; Spanish is a strong plus.

Skills That Set You Apart

  • Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment.

  • Influencing: Knowledge of effective influencing tactics and strategies; ability to impact decisions within and outside own organization.

  • Interpersonal Relationships: Knowledge of the techniques and the ability to work with a variety of individuals and groups in a constructive and collaborative manner.

  • Knowledge of Organization: Knowledge of the organization's vision, structure, culture, philosophy, operating principles, values, and code of ethics; ability to understand the value of aligning capabilities with business goals to support optimal performance.

  • Data Gathering and Reporting: Knowledge of tools, techniques and processes for gathering and reporting data; ability to practice them in a particular department or division of a company.

  • Employee Relations: Knowledge of the rights and obligations in the employee relations; ability to adhere to legal requirements when handling employee negotiations.

Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a company that values integrity, innovation, and inclusion.

  • Work with leaders who listen and empower.

  • Grow your career with opportunities for learning.

Ready to make a difference?Apply now and help us shape a workplace where people love to work.

June 27, 2025 - June 30, 2025

A Wilson Sons é uma das maiores operadoras de serviços portuários, marítimos e logísticos do Brasil, fundada em 1837 em Salvador, Bahia. Com mais de 180 anos de história, a companhia é reconhecida pela gestão eficiente de seus negócios nos segmentos em que atua.

Somos uma empresa que acompanha as tendências do mercado, investe em infraestrutura e tecnologia, inova em processos e antecipa necessidades, garantindo as melhores oportunidades para nossos parceiros.

Nossa equipe é composta por pessoas que compartilham nossos valores e princípios, alinhados à visão de futuro da Wilson Sons.

Valorizamos profissionais engajados e comprometidos com a qualidade na entrega de nossos serviços, refletindo na produtividade da companhia.

Nosso compromisso é ser a primeira escolha dos colaboradores e crescer de forma arrojada, sinérgica e sustentável.

Buscamos promover e manter um alto nível de engajamento de equipe, incentivando o crescimento conjunto.

Responsabilidades:

  1. Atuar de forma propositiva na identificação de oportunidades de melhoria nos processos de suprimentos.

  3. Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e apresentações executivas para apoio à tomada de decisão.
  4. Desenvolver e monitorar indicadores de performance relacionados à eficiência operacional da área.
  5. Realizar o acompanhamento ativo dos pedidos de compras, desde a emissão até a entrega final.
  6. Estabelecer e manter relacionamento eficiente com fornecedores, assegurando o cumprimento dos prazos e níveis de serviço.
  7. Interagir com áreas clientes para alinhamento de prazos, requisitos técnicos e priorização de demandas.
  8. Apoiar tecnicamente analistas mais juniores e contribuir para o desenvolvimento do time.

  • Ensino Médio completo, acrescido de Curso Técnico em áreas de TI ou Sistemas de Informação.

  • Vale Alimentação/Restaurante no local.
  • Plano de Saúde, Odontológico, de Academias, Telenutrição e Telemedicina para você e seus dependentes.
  • Telepsicologia para saúde mental.
  • Cesta Bebê e Programa Mães à Bordo para novas mamães.
  • Plataforma de cursos e Clube de parcerias para desenvolvimento.
  • Seguro de Vida e Canal SOS RH Saúde para apoio social.
  • Descontos em viagens.
  • Vale transporte ou transporte da empresa, dependendo da localidade.

Processo Seletivo:

  • Entrevista com o RH.
  • Entrevista com a Liderança.

Saiba mais sobre a Wilson Sons

Somos o maior operador de logística marítima e portuária do Brasil, com mais de 187 anos de experiência, atendendo mais de 5 mil clientes, incluindo armadores, importadores, exportadores, setor de energia offshore, renováveis e agronegócio. Conectamos nossos clientes ao mundo e estamos presentes na vida de milhões de pessoas.

Operamos em toda a costa brasileira, com uma frota de mais de 80 rebocadores, três terminais de contêineres, bases de apoio offshore, centros logísticos, estaleiro de construção naval e uma das maiores agências marítimas independentes do país.

Nossa longevidade resulta da busca constante por ampliar horizontes, explorar novos caminhos e criar conexões para o futuro. Lideramos a inovação no setor para crescer e compartilhar o sucesso com todos que fazem parte desta jornada.

Estamos sempre em movimento para entregar o melhor e ser referência, valorizando o trabalho bem feito e investindo no desenvolvimento e bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, que são a base de tudo que fazemos.

 Gostar de gente;

title: Insurance Manager FIFA
description:
FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (“FWWC2027”).

Job Description

The Position

The overall purpose of the Insurance Manager is to ensure the efficient implementation and supervision of the insurance coverage according to FIFA requirements. He will also be the local contact person to the local Insurance Brokers.

All tasks listed below shall be conducted in close collaboration with the FIFA Insurance Lead, and where needed with the FIFA Audit, Risk & Advisory subdivision.

Key Responsibilities

  • Implement and monitor an appropriate local insurance solution (Personal Insurances, Property Damage and Business Interruption Insurances, Marine Cargo & Liability Insurances (e.g. General Liability incl. Medical Malpractice, D&O, Error & Omissions, Motor Liability etc.)) for all FWWC 2027 entities.
  • Monitor and advice the Host Cities, Stadium Owners, Training Site Owners in regards to the insurance requirements and make sure that all is implemented in time.
  • Collaborate with Legal and Procurement teams in order to make sure that all legal contracts, which the FWWC 2027 entities will enter with sponsors, suppliers and event contractors for services required to deliver FIFA Woman World Cup 2027, have the required adequate and appropriate insurance clauses, indemnities and warranties in place.
  • Develop, implement and monitor an appropriate insurance manual and a claim insurance administration policy & procedures, to be used by FIFA Woman World Cup 2027 stakeholders.
  • In the event of a claim (Personal, Property & Liability) to record, administer and report the claim and discuss with the FIFA Lead Insurance, local Broker and/or the insurer.
  • Being the insurance interface for the local FWWC 2027 entities for all internal and external stakeholders.
  • Identification and evaluation of potential risks and proposal of countermeasures.
  • Being part and support the implementation of a local risk management program for the FIFA Woman World Cup 2027 entities.
  • Regular organization of insurance surveys.

Your profile

  • Minimum 10 years’ experience in the insurance and risk sector.
  • Solid experience in the areas of insurance on the local Brazil markets as well as experience in risk management, insurance and contract drafting
  • Strong knowledge of the insurance laws in the Brazil. Understanding of which conditions are usual “good local standard” in Brazil.
  • Good familiarity with the market players and experience in negotiations with the local insurers
  • Proven record of accomplishment in internal risk management and insurance issues settlement (especially on local mandatory insurances and employee benefits) and understanding of how high a deductible should be set etc.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
  • Spanish and/or German is a plus if spoken and written
  • Advanced skills in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project)
  • Planning software and online collaboration tools (an asset)

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Balance of Plant (BOP) Engineer – Power Generation role at Prismecs

Prismecs is at the forefront of transforming energy solutions on a global scale. As trailblazers in supply chain and engineering, we empower industrial teams to break through barriers in sectors like power generation and oil & gas. With a strategic presence in key markets around the globe. We're not just a company; we're a dynamic global force.
Prismecs merges domain expertise with cutting-edge innovation, especially in sectors such as power generation, oil & gas, metals, mining, and data centers. We specialize in tailoring solutions for maximum uptime, offering an unparalleled platform for your skills to thrive. If you're driven to make a tangible impact in the industrial realm, envision yourself contributing to a team at Prismecs that prioritizes reliability and integrity at every stage.
We're currently seeking an experienced and motivated Balance of Plant (BoP) Engineer to support on-site operations at a gas-to-power facility utilizing aero-derivative or industrial gas turbines. In this critical role, you'll manage the systems that support power generation—everything outside the turbine itself—ensuring smooth, safe, and efficient operation of the entire plant.
If you have a background in mechanical or electrical systems and experience with power plants running on natural gas or liquid fuel, this is an excellent opportunity to contribute to high-impact energy projects while expanding your career.
Start Date: Immediately
Location: On-site at a customer facility
Responsibilities

  • Oversee day-to-day operation and maintenance of Balance of Plant systems, including cooling, lubrication, fuel handling, water treatment, electrical distribution, and other auxiliary equipment.
  • Ensure seamless integration and operation of BoP systems with turbine generator packages powered by natural gas or liquid fuel.
  • Monitor system performance, diagnose anomalies, and implement reliability improvements to reduce unplanned downtime.
  • Lead and support scheduled and unscheduled maintenance activities, coordinating closely with operations and OEM teams.
  • Maintain accurate records of system performance, inspections, repairs, and upgrades for operational transparency and planning.
  • Uphold the highest standards of health, safety, and environmental compliance in all activities.
  • Provide technical input during commissioning, troubleshooting, and system optimization phases.
  • Collaborate across multidisciplinary teams to ensure alignment of BoP operations with plant performance goals.
Qualifications
  • A minimum of 5 years of experience in industrial or power plant operations, ideally involving power plants using aero-derivative or industrial turbine generators.
  • Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related field; equivalent hands-on experience will be considered.
  • Strong understanding of mechanical and electrical BoP systems and their interaction with turbine operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex plant system issues with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent organizational, documentation, and communication skills.
  • Fluent in English; Spanish or French is an asset.
  • Willingness to work on-site, including rotating shifts, weekends, or extended hours when required. Safety-conscious mindset with a proactive, solutions-driven attitude.
Applicants must submit CV/ Resume in English
At Prismecs, we empower professionals to innovate and solve real-world challenges in global energy. You'll work alongside leading experts, gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies, and contribute to projects that drive sustainable and reliable power solutions worldwide.
